### SB 583 (2025)

- **Policy ID:** `wv-sb-583-2025`
- **Sponsor / party:** Sen. Brian Helton et al.; R
- **Recorded status:** Official history records introduction and referral to Senate Economic Development on 2025-02-24. The introduced caption directs a subsequent Finance referral; no separate Finance action is recorded. The retained 2025 Senate adjournment account supports a historical regular-session nonpassage inference, not a bill-specific Died entry. The exact West Virginia Senate carryover/default-rule application remains unverified; no current-law or later-law-content conclusion is asserted.
- **Provisions:** Introduced West Virginia-Powered Data Center Incentive Act proposes personal-property salvage valuation, sales/use-tax relief and coal-electricity utility B&O treatment. Eligibility includes West Virginia location, at least $50 million new capital investment on or after January1,2025, at least50 new jobs and coal-generated electricity for at least80% of primary operational capacity; backup/redundancy/secondary capacity is excluded. Coal-generated electricity separately requires at least75% coal-derived energy from a plant burning West Virginia coal or located in the state. The printed data-center capacity definition supplies no numeric MW threshold. Introduced SB583 uses four6H cross-references despite creating article6N. SB857 changes those references to6N; the source texts are not identical. Incentives and conditions are proposals, not enacted treatment.
